scope: Read-only capacity and authority audit for the queued Qwen3.8-27B Miles dev canary

gpu_node_group.name: fleetai-training-ng-gpu
gpu_node_group.conclusion: The development B300 group has no autoscaler. Its current ceiling is the manually configured fixed count of two, not an autoscaling maximum. A user with node-group update authority can request a larger fixed count, subject to cloud capacity.

fragmentation.conclusion: Aggregate free GPUs are sufficient, but neither node has one contiguous eight-GPU slot. The two peer Deployments use explicit hostname selectors and are not Kueue-managed workloads.

kueue.conclusion: The canary has no admission, RayCluster, training Pod, GPU reservation or GPU allocation. Adding a Ready third node would make one whole-node placement possible without increasing the existing unused 16-GPU Kueue quota for this single eight-GPU canary. Any durable pool expansion should reconcile quota from live allocatable values only after the node is Ready.

cloud_capacity.resource_advice_observation: The tenant resource-advice response contained B300 entries only for uk-south1 and no gpu-b300-sxm entry for the cluster region eu-west2.
cloud_capacity.interpretation: There is no positive read-only proof that another eu-west2 B300 node is presently launchable. A fixed-count update can still be attempted by an authorized infrastructure operator, but provisioning is not guaranteed by this audit.

proved: The named Nebius profile can read the exact cluster, node group, compute instances, quotas and capacity advice.
The CLI supports changing a fixed node count with node-group update.
A companion operator rendered the fixed-count 2-to-3 update and canceled it before application, proving request syntax but not permission or capacity.
not_proved: Permission to update this shared node group
Physical capacity for another eight-B300 node in eu-west2
authority.access_check: Listing the current user's IAM access permits returned PermissionDenied, and the node-group update command has no non-mutating authorization-only dry-run. Applying a change merely to test permission was intentionally not attempted.

fastest_safe_paths.action: Ask Tong to pause one judge or, if its resource and serving constraints allow, consolidate both two-GPU judge Deployments onto one node.
fastest_safe_paths.why: This immediately frees one existing whole eight-GPU node and avoids uncertain cloud provisioning. Only the peer owner or an explicitly authorized cluster administrator should make this change.

fastest_safe_paths.action: Ask an authorized Nebius infrastructure operator to raise mk8snodegroup-e04wjmyvarh4xmetd6 from fixed_node_count 2 to 3, preserving its existing template, then wait for a third Ready node.
fastest_safe_paths.why: The existing queued canary can then be admitted unchanged if cloud provisioning succeeds. Do not duplicate or resubmit the canary.
